title: Locate and rename an internal parser helper
prompt:
Work only inside this repository (JSON5, a small JavaScript JSON5 parser).

In lib/parse.js there is an internal function named `internalize`. It is the helper that applies the optional reviver argument of the exported `parse` function. It has exactly one definition and one call site.

Task: rename that function from `internalize` to `applyReviver`, updating both its declaration and its call site so the file keeps working. Change nothing else: do not change the public API, do not change behavior, and do not touch other files.

When you are done, `JSON5.parse(text, reviver)` in lib/index.js must still apply the reviver exactly as before. You do not need to write any answer file.

commands: if git grep -q "internalize" -- lib/parse.js; then echo 'old symbol name still present' 1>&2; exit 1; fi

exclusions: Network failure while fetching the pinned commit (record as excluded, do not judge).
The wrapper never wrote a result JSON and produced no transcript (infrastructure failure, not a model failure).
